mapper.select: SELECT request_id, agreement_id, period_id, started_at, expired_at, target_contact_count, target_phone_count, target_email_count FROM monthly_customer_contact_targets WHERE request_id = #{requestId}

SELECT request_id, agreement_id, period_id, started_at, expired_at, target_contact_count, target_phone_count, target_email_count FROM monthly_customer_contact_targets WHERE request_id = #{requestId} AND agreement_id = #{agreementId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM monthly_customer_contact_targets WHERE agreement_id = #{agreementId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO monthly_customer_contact_targets (request_id, agreement_id, period_id, started_at, expired_at, target_contact_count, target_phone_count, target_email_count) VALUES (#{description.requestId}, #{agreementId}, #{description.periodId}, #{description.startedAt}, #{description.expiredAt}, #{description.targetContactCount}, #{description.targetPhoneCount}, #{description.targetEmailCount})
